data.content:
Critical PHP Security Advisory

Dear Customers,

The PHP Security Team has disclosed two related critical vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Both have a CVSS v4.0 score of 9.2.

Security Impact

  • Under specific conditions, unauthenticated attackers may send crafted HTTP requests to execute arbitrary code with web worker privileges.
  • Exploitation attempts have been observed. Patch promptly and review logs.


Two Related Flaws Enable Remote Compromise

Prioritize internet-facing services. Exploitability varies with PHP configuration, extensions and application behavior.

How HTTP Requests Reach PHP

Vulnerability Details

  • CVE-2026-109618

An out-of-memory (OOM) error can interrupt initialization. Cleanup may then use incompletely initialized data, causing memory corruption and remote code execution.

  • CVE-2026-109619

Global state can retain pointers to freed request memory. A later request handled by the same worker may reuse that stale state, causing a use-after-free.

Both flaws may allow unauthenticated RCE under specific conditions. Execution uses web worker privileges and does not necessarily grant root access.


Immediate Update Recommended

Install a release below or a later patched release in the same branch, or apply a complete vendor-validated backport. Configuration changes do not replace patching.

TrafficShaper uses Layer 7 visibility to simplify network management.

When an enterprise network suddenly slows down, the first reaction is often, "Is there not enough bandwidth?"

However, the real cause of network congestion may not be insufficient bandwidth. Certain applications, users, or services may be consuming excessive network resources. For example, video streaming, cloud services, file transfers, SaaS applications, video conferencing, and even background automatic updates can unknowingly affect critical business services such as ERP, VPN, and servers.

If IT teams can only see "how much total bandwidth is being used" but cannot identify who is using it, which applications are consuming it, or where the traffic is going, simply adding more bandwidth may only provide a temporary solution.


The First Step in Network Management Is Not Limiting Bandwidth, but Understanding Traffic

TrafficShaper uses Layer 7 Application Identification to help IT teams gain clear visibility into application and traffic usage across enterprise networks, enabling them to quickly identify:

✓ Which applications consume the most bandwidth

✓ Which users or devices consume the most network resources

✓ Which domains and services are the main sources of network traffic

✓ Whether there are abnormal trends in inbound and outbound bandwidth usage

✓ Whether non-essential traffic is affecting critical business services

Helping IT teams move beyond the vague complaint of "the network is slow" to quickly identify the root cause.


Are You Experiencing These Network Challenges?

1. Upgraded your bandwidth, but the network is still slow?

The problem may not be insufficient bandwidth, but inefficient traffic allocation.

2. Are ERP, VPN, and video conferencing frequently affected by other traffic?

Non-critical applications may be consuming bandwidth needed by essential business services.

3. Does IT still need to troubleshoot network issues one by one?

Without traffic visibility, identifying the root cause can be time-consuming.

4. Not sure how much bandwidth SaaS, video streaming, and cloud services consume?

Without clear application visibility, developing effective management policies becomes difficult.

5. Have traffic data but struggle to turn it into management policies?

Visibility alone is not enough. Effective traffic control is essential.

From Visibility to Smarter Network Management

TrafficShaper goes beyond traffic monitoring, enabling enterprises to establish traffic management policies based on application and business requirements:

·      Critical Services: ERP, VPN, CRM, and video conferencing — prioritize bandwidth for business-critical applications.

·      General Office Applications: Web, Email, Office 365, and Google Workspace — allocate bandwidth according to business needs.

·      Non-Critical Applications: YouTube, large file downloads, and video streaming — limit bandwidth or lower traffic priority.

TrafficShaper ensures that limited network resources are prioritized for the enterprise services that matter most.


TrafficShaper Helps IT Teams Shift from Reactive Troubleshooting to Proactive Decision-Making

✓ Layer 7 Application Identification: Identify actual application and service traffic, beyond just IP addresses and ports.

✓ Traffic Visualization: Quickly monitor Top Applications, Top Domains, users, and bandwidth usage trends.

✓ Bandwidth Management: Define traffic management policies based on application, user, and service requirements.

✓ Critical Service Prioritization: Ensure business-critical applications receive the network resources they need.

✓ Faster Troubleshooting: Reduce IT troubleshooting time, manual analysis, and management workload.

Bandwidth Should Be Managed with Data, Not Guesswork

As enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and cloud services continue to grow, simply adding more bandwidth may no longer be enough to solve network performance issues.

Enterprises need to understand who is using their bandwidth, where it is being consumed, and which services truly deserve priority.

data.content:
AgileLink Builds Multi-Link Network Resilience with Dedicated Lines, Broadband, 4G/5G, and STARLINK

For modern enterprises, the network is no longer just a means of accessing the Internet. It is a critical foundation that supports ERP systems, cloud services, VPNs, video conferencing, inter-site connectivity, and daily business operations. That is why many enterprises deploy a second network connection as a backup. But the real question is: Does having a second line really mean your network will never go down? Not necessarily.

When the primary connection fails, enterprises may still face service disruptions and operational impact if the backup link cannot take over immediately, if different applications lack appropriate traffic policies, or if IT staff still need to switch connections manually. Truly effective network redundancy should go beyond simply having an additional line — it should provide multi-link integration and intelligent traffic management.

Multi-Link Redundancy, Uninterrupted Services, and Enhanced Security

Enterprise network environments are becoming increasingly complex, and a single dedicated line is often no longer sufficient to support all business scenarios.

AgileLink Next-Generation WAN Management combines WAN Load Balancing and DNS Security, and supports the integration of multiple types of WAN connections, including dedicated lines, broadband, 4G/5G mobile networks, and STARLINK satellite connectivity.

By integrating multiple network sources, enterprises can build a more flexible network architecture based on their operating environments and application requirements. When one connection fails, other available links can immediately serve as alternative paths, reducing the operational risks caused by a single point of network failure.

Beyond Failover: Make Sure Traffic Takes the Right Path

The value of multiple network links should not be limited to failover scenarios. In daily operations, enterprises can also use AgileLink’s Policy-Based Routing (PBR) to determine the optimal traffic path based on different applications, services, or network conditions. This transforms multiple network connections from simple “backup links” into flexible network resources that enterprises can actively manage and utilize.

Applications include:

• Government Agencies: Route official document traffic through dedicated lines while directing video traffic to secondary links.

• Enterprise Headquarters / Branch Offices: Centralized management with automatic failover.

• Multinational Enterprises: Optimize international connectivity and reduce network latency.

• Satellite / Remote Sites: Hybrid connectivity with STARLINK, MPLS, PPPoE, and 5G.

• Legacy Equipment Replacement: Provide alternatives for End-of-Life (EOL) network equipment.

• Critical Application Assurance: Optimize traffic for SaaS applications and server environments.

AgileLink Makes Every Network Link Work Smarter

With AgileLink, enterprises can flexibly allocate traffic based on different applications and business requirements, reducing the impact of single-link failures. AgileLink helps enterprises achieve:

✓ Multi-WAN Integration: Integrate multiple Internet and WAN connections.

✓ Multi-Link Redundancy: Reduce operational risks caused by the failure of a single network link.

✓ Policy-Based Routing: Route traffic based on applications, source, destination, or defined policies.

✓ Flexible Network Integration: Support multiple connection types, including dedicated lines, broadband, 4G/5G, and STARLINK.

✓ Enhanced Network Resilience: Maintain critical services and inter-site connectivity even during unexpected network disruptions.

data.content:
As SaaS, cloud services, video conferencing, and AI applications become part of daily enterprise operations, network traffic is no longer just about “how fast the internet is.” Instead, it is about whether critical services are properly prioritized, user behavior is fully visible, and anomalies can be detected and traced in real time. Relying solely on traditional firewalls or bandwidth upgrades is no longer sufficient to handle the complexity of modern application traffic and the growing demands of network management.

UGUARD Traffic Shaper is purpose-built for modern enterprises. With Layer 7 application identification and intelligent traffic management, it enables IT teams to clearly understand who is using which applications and services, and at what time.

By applying precise bandwidth allocation and control based on users, groups, applications, and website categories, UGUARD Traffic Shaper ensures stable performance for mission-critical business operations, cloud systems, and video conferencing services.

Traffic Shaper features an intuitive, visualized dashboard that transforms complex network traffic data into real-time charts, enabling IT administrators to quickly gain a clear overview of overall network usage.

Through Layer 7 QoS application-layer traffic identification, the system clearly presents real-time traffic dynamics across different application services, including upload/download trends, top application rankings, and traffic distribution ratios, empowering IT teams to make more accurate and informed management decisions.

The interface consolidates key metrics such as device status, CPU and memory utilization, and concurrent connection counts, while providing real-time visibility into Top Domains and service traffic distribution. This allows administrators to quickly identify high-traffic sources and potential performance bottlenecks.

When combined with user identity recognition and authentication mechanisms, Traffic Shaper enables more effective bandwidth control and traffic optimization, ensuring priority for critical applications while significantly reducing the operational and response burden on IT teams.

Traffic Shaper – Diversified Deployment Model

In terms of deployment, Traffic Shaper supports both Inline and SPAN modes, allowing flexible integration into existing network architectures. It also offers hardware-based and software-based bypass designs to ensure uninterrupted operations, helping enterprises build a more resilient and comprehensive network usage management framework.

In the cloud- and AI-driven era, Traffic Shaper is more than just a traffic management solution—it is a critical tool that helps enterprises enhance network experience, strengthen visibility, and improve operational efficiency.

data.summary: We provide you with a better network solution: AgileLink New Generation WAN Management (NGWM)
data.content:
We provide you with a better network solution:
AgileLink New Generation WAN Management (NGWM)

AgileLink offers an integrated solution for both virtual and physical lines, helping administrators consolidate multiple connections and establish virtual bandwidth between different physical offices, improving the speed, stability, and quality of critical traffic transmission. When a line failure occurs, AgileLink automatically selects a higher-quality line for data transmission, ensuring that even if users are on a VoIP call at the moment of failover, there is no interruption or delay. AgileLink features line status detection — when a line anomaly is detected, it automatically redirects the affected service traffic to a healthy line, preventing service disruptions from impacting business operations. Through the integration of DNS resolution and line status detection, AgileLink effectively maintains continuous enterprise service availability.
